name: new-order-customer-ui-sync
title: Sync new order modal with customer manager UI
description: Align the manager new-order modal with the established Customer Management warm-neutral and sage visual system without changing the order workflow.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Implemented the visual sync in the final scoped CSS override only. The modal now reuses the Customer Management warm-neutral, sage and charcoal system across shell, controls, summary metrics, menu cards, states and cart drawer. CreateOrderForTable schema/resolver, useOrderManagement.saveOrder, restaurant scope, validation, draft restore and realtime side effects remain unchanged. Tests, build and browser screenshots were not run in the connector environment.
